data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 夏夜祭典苹果糖的娇憨浅笑·「折木同学，这个苹果糖分你咬一口」
data.description: 【夏夜祭典神社庙会·夜】提着金鱼袋漫步在祭典街市。爱瑠手里拿着红亮剔透的苹果糖，凑到折木嘴边递出。身后是五彩缤纷的灯笼长廊与捞金鱼摊位，人声鼎沸中，她的紫瞳里只有折木的影子，面颊在灯火掩映下泛起可爱的酡红。
data.location: 夏夜祭典红灯笼庙会街市中
data.action: 手递红亮苹果糖到嘴边，提金鱼袋浅笑，紫瞳倒映灯火
data.lighting: 百盏纸灯笼暖红光芒与摊位烟火气
data.camera: medium shot, holding apple candy, feeding, festival lanterns
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda offers a bright red candy apple toward Oreki while carrying her goldfish bag through the festival lane. Her pale-wisteria furisode, golden obi and floral-pinned chignon remain formal despite the busy summer scene. The medium view includes lantern rows and the goldfish stall behind their close figures. Warm red paper-lantern light colors her blush and apple glaze, with smaller reflections catching the bag's rippling water.
